preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of friends N and roads M must be between 2 and 100,000.
The road index K must be between 1 and M.
The friends A and B must be valid indices, and the road length C must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the distance from A to point P and the maximum distance from P to all friends, both rounded to 5 decimal places.
The distance from A to point P and the maximum distance must be non-negative.
The distance from A to point P must not exceed the length of the road C.
